primary_anchor_zh: 方下巴、黑色卷发和赭石色工作外套
story_reason_zh: 他去水槽润湿工具，随后回到雕塑台

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 中年拉丁裔男雕塑家在北窗照明的雕塑工作室，缓慢抹平大型黏土头像的表面。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 缓慢抹平大型黏土头像的表面
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 方下巴、黑色卷发和赭石色工作外套占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走出画面；随后呈现空转凳、大型黏土头像和工具台。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空转凳、大型黏土头像和工具台

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.main_action_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚展示方下巴、黑色卷发和赭石色工作外套，并保持相近景别与主体占比。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a middle-aged Latino man with a square jaw, black curly hair, and an ochre work jacket at a sculpture stand beneath a north-facing window. He smooths the surface of a large clay bust with slow hand movements. Cool window light reveals the broad clay forms.

A fixed medium shot shows a middle-aged Latino man with a square jaw, black curly hair, and an ochre work jacket walking slowly through the sculpture-studio doorway until he leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty swivel stool, the large clay bust, and the tool table. A damp cloth releases a slow drop of water.

A fixed medium shot shows a middle-aged Latino man with a square jaw, black curly hair, and an ochre work jacket walking slowly back through the sculpture-studio doorway and settling at a sculpture stand beneath a north-facing window.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空转凳、大型黏土头像和工具台
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 主体经由雕塑工作室门口缓慢走回画面，并停回原活动位置
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
